title: The human figure G90 opens texts abroad
authors: Erin Rae Toppe; prepared with Claude
applies_to: Indus inscriptions found outside the Indus region (Mesopotamia, Iran, the Gulf, Oman, Central Asia) that are not in the paragorth merged Wells/ICIT copy (data/icit_merged_paragorth/merged-corpus-canonical.json), transcribed in Wells/ICIT numbers.
claim: Among such texts that contain G90, G90 is the first or second sign in at least half, and is right after the jar G740 in fewer than a quarter. At home (exploration) G90 is first in 4% of uses, last in 71%, and after G740 in 52 of 70.
basis: results/g90_scouting.md (abroad texts seen: 5 of 6 with G90 first or second, none after G740).
counts_as_tested_if: at least 6 new abroad texts contain G90 with the G90 position legible
note: Written before any such new text is seen.
